pageNotFound: The page you are looking for does not exist.
errorDescription: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This status change is not allowed from the current state.
TC_REQUIRED_FOR_TRANSFER: Issue a Transfer Certificate before marking the student as transferred out.
LAST_GUARDIAN_CANNOT_BE_DELETED: A student must have at least one guardian. Link another guardian before removing this one.
INSTITUTE_CODE_DUPLICATE: An institute with this code already exists.
SETUP_NOT_COMPLETE: Institute setup must be completed before activation.
RESELLER_INVALID: The selected reseller is not found or inactive.
SYSTEM_RESELLER_PROTECTED: The system reseller cannot be modified.
CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: This record was modified by another user. Please refresh and try again.
ACADEMIC_YEAR_OVERLAP: The date range overlaps with an existing academic year.
INVALID_DATE_RANGE: Start date must be before end date.
LAST_ACADEMIC_YEAR: Cannot delete the last remaining academic year.
YEAR_ALREADY_ACTIVE: Another academic year is already active.
STANDARD_NAME_DUPLICATE: This academic year already has a standard with this name. Type a different name, or edit the existing standard instead.
SECTION_NAME_DUPLICATE: This standard already has a section with this name. Type a different name, such as the next letter.
HAS_ACTIVE_ENROLLMENTS: Cannot delete — students are currently enrolled.
HAS_RECORDED_ASSESSMENTS: Cannot delete — assessments have been recorded.
STREAM_REQUIRED: A stream must be selected for this standard.
STUDENT_ACADEMIC_NOT_FOUND: One or more of the selected students has no record in this academic year. Refresh the list and try again.
SECTION_HAS_STUDENTS: This section still has students. Move them to another section before deleting it.
STUDENT_ALREADY_ENROLLED: This student is already enrolled in that academic year.
STUDENT_YEAR_HAS_RECORDS: This student already has attendance, marks or report cards in this year, so they cannot be removed from it.
STANDARD_NOT_FOUND: That class was not found in this academic year. Refresh and try again.
SECTION_NOT_FOUND: That section was not found in the chosen class. Refresh and try again.
SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: That subject was not found in this institute. Refresh and try again.
MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND: That person is not a member of this institute. Refresh and try again.
MESSAGING_SENDER_NOT_FOUND: That messaging sender was not found. Refresh and try again.
MESSAGING_SENDER_EXISTS: A sender is already registered for this institute, or this number is already in use.
ACADEMIC_YEAR_NOT_FOUND: That academic year was not found. Refresh and try again.
ACADEMIC_YEAR_NOT_ACTIVE: No academic year is active for this.
CERTIFICATE_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE: That certificate template has been deactivated. Pick an active template.
EMPLOYEE_ID_DUPLICATE: Another current staff member already has this employee ID.
network: Check your internet connection, then try again.
ACADEMIC_YEAR_ARCHIVED: This academic year is archived, so it cannot be changed.
NO_ACTIVE_ACADEMIC_YEAR: Your institute has no active academic year. Activate one on the Academic years page, then try again.
HOLIDAY_NOT_FOUND: This holiday no longer exists. Refresh the page.
EXAM_NOT_FOUND: This exam no longer exists. Refresh the page.
EXAM_INVALID_CONFIG: This change does not fit the exam's datesheet, for example two papers for one section at the same time. Check the datesheet and try again.
EXAM_SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND: This datesheet entry no longer exists. Refresh the page.
EXAM_TERM_NOT_FOUND: This exam term no longer exists. Refresh the page.
GRADING_SCHEME_NOT_FOUND: This grading scheme no longer exists. Refresh the page.
REPORT_CARD_NOT_FOUND: This report card no longer exists. Refresh the page.
GROUP_NOT_FOUND: This group no longer exists. Refresh the page.
GROUP_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer in the group. Refresh the page.
INSTITUTE_GROUP_NOT_FOUND: This institute group no longer exists. Refresh the page.
STAFF_NOT_FOUND: This staff member no longer exists. Refresh the page.
STAFF_QUALIFICATION_NOT_FOUND: This qualification no longer exists. Refresh the page.
ROLE_NOT_FOUND: The role this needs is missing from your institute. Ask your administrator to check Settings → Roles.
GUARDIAN_NOT_FOUND: This guardian no longer exists. Refresh the page.
GUARDIAN_ALREADY_LINKED: This guardian is already linked to this student.
STUDENT_NOT_FOUND: This student no longer exists. Refresh the page.
ADMISSION_NUMBER_TAKEN: Another student already has this admission number. Use a different one.
ADMISSION_NUMBER_SERIES_EXHAUSTED: No free admission number is left in this class's series, so the student was not added. Give the student an admission number in an import file, or ask Roviq support to change your institute's admission number format.
SECTION_REQUIRED: Choose a section, then try again.
SECTION_STANDARD_MISMATCH: This section belongs to a different standard. Choose a section of the right standard.
INVALID_LOCALE_SETTINGS: Choose the supported languages, including English and the default language.
USER_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: Your profile could not be found. Sign out and sign in again.
NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists. Refresh the page.
BAD_REQUEST: Some of the details were not accepted. Check what you entered and try again.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the details were not accepted. Check what you entered and try again.
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
STANDARD_ORDER_DUPLICATE: Another standard in this academic year already has this position in the order. Pick an unused number, or move the other standard first.
ACADEMIC_YEAR_LABEL_DUPLICATE: This institute already has an academic year with this label, possibly a deleted one. Use a different label.
EXAM_NAME_DUPLICATE: This academic year already has an exam with this name. Type a different name, for example add the term.
EXAM_TERM_NAME_DUPLICATE: This academic year already has an exam term with this name. Type a different name.
EXAM_SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE: This exam already has a paper for this subject and section. Edit the existing paper instead of adding another.
GRADING_SCHEME_NAME_DUPLICATE: This institute already has a grading scheme with this name. Type a different name.
GRADING_SCHEME_INVALID_BANDS: The grade bands overlap, leave gaps or repeat a grade. Give each band its own grade and make the ranges cover 0 to 100 without overlap.
CO_SCHOLASTIC_AREA_NAME_DUPLICATE: This institute already has a co-scholastic area with this name. Type a different name.
SUBJECT_TOPIC_CODE_DUPLICATE: This subject already has a topic with this code for this standard. Type a different code.
REPORT_CARD_NAME_DUPLICATE: This academic year already has a report card with this name. Type a different name.
GROUP_NAME_DUPLICATE: This institute already has a group with this name. Type a different name, or open the existing group.
INSTITUTE_GROUP_CODE_DUPLICATE: Another institute group already uses this code. Type a different code.
INSTITUTE_GROUP_MEMBER_DUPLICATE: This person is already a member of the institute group. Refresh the member list.
ATTENDANCE_SLOT_TAKEN: Attendance for this section, date and period was just started by someone else. Refresh to open it.
EMAIL_TAKEN: This email address already belongs to a Roviq account. Use a different email address, or leave it empty.
